pr_body:
By accident ParsedMediaType was not truly immutable and it was possible
to modify other ParsedMediaType's by accident when building.
ParsedMediaType#parseMediaType(XContentType,Map) was modifying
ParsedMediaTypes within XContentType. This should never happen.

This commit is addressing this by making Map of parameters immutable.

closes #67545

review_comment:
I dunno how paranoid we oughta be here, but I think this one factory method would still leak mutability. Somebody could pass in a parameters map, and then modify it later. IIUC the `Collections.unmodifiableMap` above only enforces an immutable view, if the underlying map is modified, it doesn't do anything for us.

`this.parameters = Map.copyOf(parameters);` above would protect against even this, too, right?
@joegallo this is great point. you are right -  `unmodifiableMap` is just an immutable view. copyOf is better there. Thanks for the fix!!!
